title: Biography/memoir of Eugene T. Carson, flight engineer/gunner, 560th BS, 388th BG (Schweinfurt chapter)
notes: First-hand account (written later). 22 scheduled, take-off crash of Swift's Hard Luck, 5 aborts, 16 attacked, 3 landed away, no losses; 388th low group of lead wing with 96th; Carson flew tail in Tiger Girl 42-3555 with Ingebritsen, Meginnies, Allred. Includes Special Orders 205 (9 Sep 1943) crew No. 60 roster.
